note: Original recipes. Nutrition is estimated per serving from USDA FoodData Central values for the amounts listed.

recipes.title: Lean Irish stew
recipes.desc: Slow-simmered lamb, potatoes and carrots in a light, peppery broth thickened by the potatoes themselves.
ingredients: 9 oz lean lamb leg, trimmed and cut in 1-inch cubes
14 oz floury potatoes, peeled and cut in chunks
Pinch of salt, black pepper, 2 sprigs thyme, 1 bay leaf, chopped parsley
ingredientsMetric: 250 g lean lamb leg, trimmed and cut in 2.5 cm cubes
400 g floury potatoes, peeled and cut in chunks
Pinch of salt, black pepper, 2 sprigs thyme, 1 bay leaf, chopped parsley
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat, in two batches. Add the onion and cook 3 minutes.
Add the stock, thyme and bay leaf. Cover and simmer gently for 45 minutes.
Add the potatoes, carrots and leek. Simmer, covered, 30–35 minutes more until everything is tender and some potato has broken down to thicken the broth.
Skim off any fat, remove the bay leaf, season with the salt and plenty of pepper, and scatter with parsley.

recipes.title: Beef and Guinness stew
recipes.desc: Lean beef braised in stout with mushrooms and carrots, served over steamed potatoes.
ingredients: 10 oz lean stewing beef, trimmed and cubed
Thyme, bay leaf and black pepper
ingredientsMetric: 300 g lean stewing beef, trimmed and cubed
Thyme, bay leaf and black pepper
steps: Toss the beef in the flour and pepper. Brown it in the oil in a casserole over medium-high heat, then set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the same pot for 5 minutes, then stir in the tomato paste.
Return the beef with the stout, stock, carrots, thyme and bay. Cover and cook in a 325°F oven (or simmer very gently) for 1½ hours.
Add the mushrooms and cook 30 minutes more, uncovered, until the beef is tender and the sauce has thickened.
Steam the potatoes for the last 20 minutes and serve the stew over them.

recipes.title: Chicken and leek filo pie
recipes.desc: A creamy-tasting chicken, leek and mushroom pie with a crisp filo lid instead of heavy pastry.
ingredients: 2 tsp rapeseed or olive oil, divided
7 oz green beans, steamed, to serve
ingredientsMetric: 2 tsp rapeseed or olive oil, divided
200 g green beans, steamed, to serve
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Brown the chicken in 1 tsp oil, then add the leeks and mushrooms and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the flour, then gradually add the stock and milk. Simmer, stirring, until thickened. Add the mustard, thyme and pepper.
Pour into a small pie dish. Brush the filo with the remaining oil, scrunch the sheets loosely and lay them over the top.
Bake 15–20 minutes until golden and bubbling. Serve with the green beans.

recipes.title: Baked salmon with champ and kale
recipes.desc: Ulster champ (scallion mash) with oven-baked salmon, garlicky kale and lemon.
ingredients: 14 oz potatoes, peeled and cut up
ingredientsMetric: 400 g potatoes, peeled and cut up
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15–18 minutes until tender. Meanwhile heat the oven to 400°F.
Bake the salmon on a lined tray with lemon juice, dill and pepper for 12–14 minutes, until it flakes.
Warm the milk with the scallions for 2 minutes. Drain and mash the potatoes, then beat in the scallion milk and butter.
Wilt the kale in the oil with a splash of water for 3–4 minutes. Serve the salmon on the champ with the kale and lemon wedges.

recipes.title: Pork tenderloin with colcannon and Bramley apple
recipes.desc: Herb-roasted pork with cabbage colcannon and a sharp, barely sweet Bramley apple sauce.
ingredients: 1 Bramley or Granny Smith apple, peeled and chopped
14 oz potatoes, peeled and cut up
Fresh sage or thyme and black pepper
ingredientsMetric: 1 Bramley apple (200 g), peeled and chopped
400 g potatoes, peeled and cut up
Fresh sage or thyme and black pepper
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Rub the pork with the oil, mustard, herbs and pepper, sear it in an ovenproof pan, then roast 15–18 minutes until it reaches 145°F. Rest 5 minutes.
Simmer the apple with the honey and 2 tbsp water for 8–10 minutes until it collapses into a sauce.
Boil the potatoes until tender; steam the cabbage over them for the last 5 minutes.
Mash the potatoes with the milk and butter, fold in the cabbage and scallions, then serve with sliced pork and the apple sauce.

recipes.title: Lighter seafood chowder
recipes.desc: An Irish-style chowder of cod, smoked haddock and shrimp in a milky broth, with no cream.
ingredients: 1 tsp butter and 1 tsp rapeseed oil
1½ cups low-sodium fish or vegetable stock
2½ oz undyed smoked haddock, in chunks
Chopped parsley, dill and black pepper
ingredientsMetric: 1 tsp butter and 1 tsp rapeseed oil
350 ml low-sodium fish or vegetable stock
75 g undyed smoked haddock, in chunks
Chopped parsley, dill and black pepper
steps: Soften the onion and celery in the butter and oil for 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and stock, cover and simmer 10–12 minutes until the potatoes are just tender.
Mix the cornstarch with a little of the milk, then stir it in with the rest of the milk. Bring back to a gentle simmer.
Add the fish and shrimp and poach 4–5 minutes until the fish flakes and the shrimp are pink. Finish with herbs and pepper.

recipes.title: Mussels in Armagh cider
recipes.desc: Rope-grown mussels steamed in dry Northern Irish cider with shallots and a spoon of crème fraîche, with soda bread.
ingredients: 2¼ lb mussels in their shells, cleaned (about 10 oz meat)
¾ cup dry cider (Armagh if you can get it)
2 tbsp light crème fraîche or sour cream
ingredientsMetric: 1 kg mussels in their shells, cleaned (about 300 g meat)
steps: Scrub the mussels and discard any that are cracked or stay open when tapped.
Soften the shallots and garlic in the butter and oil in a large pot for 3 minutes.
Turn up the heat, add the cider and mussels, cover tightly and steam 4–5 minutes, shaking the pot, until the shells open. Discard any that stay shut.
Stir the crème fraîche and parsley into the juices and serve in bowls with the soda bread for dipping.

recipes.title: Lighter Ulster fry
recipes.desc: Breakfast-for-dinner: grilled back bacon, poached eggs, tomatoes, mushrooms and beans with wholemeal soda bread instead of fried farls.
ingredients: 4 slices lean back bacon or Canadian bacon, fat trimmed
½ tsp oil, for the mushrooms
ingredientsMetric: 4 lean back bacon rashers, fat trimmed (100 g)
½ tsp oil, for the mushrooms
steps: Heat the broiler. Broil the bacon and tomato halves for 6–8 minutes, turning the bacon once.
Cook the mushrooms in the oil in a nonstick pan for 5 minutes. Warm the beans in a small pan.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water for 3–4 minutes.
Toast the soda bread and plate everything up.

recipes.title: Chicken-sausage coddle
recipes.desc: Dublin's one-pot supper made lighter with chicken sausages instead of pork sausages and bacon, slow-cooked with potatoes and onions.
ingredients: Thyme, chopped parsley and black pepper
ingredientsMetric: Thyme, chopped parsley and black pepper
steps: Heat the oven to 325°F. Brown the sausages in a nonstick casserole, then cut the sausages in thirds.
Layer the onion, potatoes, carrots, sausages in the pot, seasoning each layer with pepper and thyme.
Pour over the stock, cover and bake for 1 hour, uncovering for the last 15 minutes.
Spoon into bowls with the broth and lots of parsley.

recipes.title: Boxty with smoked salmon
recipes.desc: Northern potato pancakes, dry-fried in a little oil, topped with smoked salmon, lemony yogurt and chives.
ingredients: 7 oz potatoes (half grated raw, half boiled and mashed)
Lemon juice, chives and black pepper
ingredientsMetric: 200 g potatoes (half grated raw, half boiled and mashed)
Lemon juice, chives and black pepper
steps: Squeeze the grated potato dry in a clean towel, then mix with the mashed potato, flour, baking powder, egg and buttermilk into a thick batter.
Brush a nonstick pan with the oil and cook spoonfuls of batter over medium heat, 3–4 minutes a side, until golden and cooked through.
Stir lemon juice, chives and pepper into the yogurt.
Top the boxty with the smoked salmon and yogurt, and serve with the salad.

recipes.title: Hake with crushed potatoes and peas
recipes.desc: Roast hake on lemony crushed potatoes and minted peas, with a few capers for punch.
ingredients: 2 hake or cod fillets (5 oz each)
Fresh mint, parsley and black pepper
ingredientsMetric: Fresh mint, parsley and black pepper
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Boil the potatoes 15 minutes, adding the peas for the last 3.
Meanwhile put the hake on a lined tray, brush with 1 tsp oil, season with pepper and roast 10–12 minutes until it flakes.
Drain the potatoes and peas, crush lightly with a fork, and stir in the rest of the oil, lemon juice, capers, mint and parsley.
Serve the hake on the crushed potatoes.

recipes.title: Vegetable and pearl barley broth
recipes.desc: A thick Ulster-style broth of root vegetables, leeks, kale, beans and barley.
ingredients: 7 oz canned butter beans, no salt added, drained
ingredientsMetric: 200 g tinned butter beans, no salt added, drained
steps: Soften the onion, carrots, leek, celery and rutabaga in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the barley, stock and thyme. Cover and simmer 35–40 minutes until the barley is tender.
Stir in the beans and kale and cook 5 minutes more. Season with pepper and parsley.

recipes.title: Miso-glazed salmon with pak choi
recipes.desc: Japanese-style broiled salmon with a sweet-savory miso glaze, ginger greens and brown rice.
ingredients: 1 tsp rice vinegar and 1 tsp grated ginger
ingredientsMetric: 1 tsp rice vinegar and 1 tsp grated ginger
steps: Cook the rice according to the package.
Mix the miso, honey, soy, vinegar and half the ginger. Spread over the salmon and leave 10 minutes.
Broil the salmon on a lined tray for 8–10 minutes until glazed and just cooked, watching that the glaze doesn't burn.
Stir-fry the bok choy in the sesame oil with the rest of the ginger for 3 minutes. Serve with the rice and scallions.

recipes.title: Bibimbap with lean beef
recipes.desc: A Korean rice bowl of seasoned vegetables, garlicky beef, a soft egg and a spoon of gochujang.
ingredients: 2 tsp sesame oil, divided, plus 1 tsp neutral oil
ingredientsMetric: 2 tsp sesame oil, divided, plus 1 tsp neutral oil
steps: Cook the rice. Blanch the spinach and bean sprouts for 1 minute, squeeze dry and toss each with a little sesame oil.
Stir-fry the carrot and zucchini separately in the neutral oil for 2 minutes each.
Brown the beef with the garlic and soy, breaking it up, for 5 minutes.
Fry or poach the eggs. Divide the rice between bowls, arrange the vegetables and beef on top, add an egg and the gochujang, and mix at the table.

recipes.title: Greek cod plaki
recipes.desc: Cod baked over potatoes in a tomato, pepper and olive sauce with oregano and lemon.
ingredients: 1 tsp dried oregano, parsley and lemon wedges
ingredientsMetric: 1 tin (400 g) chopped tomatoes, no salt added
1 tsp dried oregano, parsley and lemon wedges
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Toss the potatoes with half the oil and roast in a baking dish for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile soften the onion, garlic and pepper in the rest of the oil for 6 minutes, then add the tomatoes and oregano and simmer 10 minutes.
Lay the cod on the potatoes, spoon the sauce over and scatter with the olives.
Bake 15–18 minutes until the fish flakes. Finish with parsley and lemon.

recipes.title: Spanish shrimp and chickpea stew
recipes.desc: Smoky paprika, saffron and tomato stew with chickpeas, spinach and shrimp.
ingredients: 1 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp cumin, pinch of saffron
1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, no salt added, drained
ingredientsMetric: 1 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp cumin, pinch of saffron
1 tin (400 g) chopped tomatoes, no salt added
1 tin (240 g drained) chickpeas, no salt added
steps: Soften the onion, garlic and pepper in the oil for 6 minutes. Stir in the spices for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas and stock and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the shrimp and spinach and cook 3–4 minutes until the shrimp are pink.
Serve with parsley and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.title: Turkish red lentil soup
recipes.desc: Mercimek çorbası: a silky red lentil soup with cumin, chili and dried mint, brightened with lemon.
ingredients: 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp chili flakes, 1 tsp dried mint
ingredientsMetric: 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp chilli flakes, 1 tsp dried mint
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and garlic in half the oil for 6 minutes. Stir in the tomato paste and cumin.
Add the lentils and stock, bring to a boil and simmer 20 minutes until the lentils collapse.
Blend until smooth and add lemon juice to taste.
Warm the remaining oil with the chili flakes and mint for 30 seconds and drizzle over each bowl.

recipes.title: Chicken shawarma bowl
recipes.desc: Lebanese-spiced chicken thighs over herby bulgur with cucumber, tomato and a garlicky yogurt-tahini sauce.
ingredients: Juice of ½ lemon and 2 cloves garlic
1 tsp each cumin and paprika, ½ tsp each cinnamon and allspice
ingredientsMetric: Juice of ½ lemon and 2 cloves garlic
1 tsp each cumin and paprika, ½ tsp each cinnamon and allspice
steps: Toss the chicken with the oil, lemon, half the garlic and the spices. Marinate at least 15 minutes (or overnight).
Pour boiling water over the bulgur to cover by 1 cm, cover and leave 15 minutes, then fluff with parsley and mint.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken 5–6 minutes a side until it reaches 165°F, then slice.
Mix the yogurt, tahini and remaining garlic with a splash of water. Build bowls of bulgur, chicken, cucumber, tomato and onion, and spoon over the sauce.

recipes.title: Fish Veracruz
recipes.desc: Mexican Gulf-coast white fish simmered in tomato sauce with olives, capers and jalapeño, over brown rice.
ingredients: 10 oz cod, snapper or other white fish
1 tsp dried oregano and 1 bay leaf
ingredientsMetric: 300 g cod, snapper or other white fish
1 tin (400 g) chopped tomatoes, no salt added
1 tsp dried oregano and 1 bay leaf
steps: Cook the rice.
Soften the onion, garlic and jalapeño in the oil for 5 minutes. Add the tomatoes, olives, capers, oregano and bay and simmer 10 minutes.
Nestle in the fish, cover and simmer 8–10 minutes until it flakes.
Serve over the rice with plenty of sauce.

recipes.title: Peruvian chicken with salsa criolla
recipes.desc: Lime, garlic and cumin roast chicken with quinoa, sharp red-onion salsa criolla and avocado.
ingredients: 1 tsp oil, 2 cloves garlic, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika
1 red chili or a little aji amarillo paste
ingredientsMetric: 1 tsp oil, 2 cloves garlic, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp paprika
1 red chilli or a little aji amarillo paste
steps: Rub the chicken with the oil, garlic, spices, salt and a third of the lime juice. Leave 15 minutes.
Heat the oven to 425°F and roast the chicken 20–22 minutes until it reaches 165°F. Rest, then slice.
Cook the quinoa. Soak the onion in cold water for 10 minutes, drain, and toss with the chili, tomatoes, cilantro and remaining lime juice.
Serve the chicken on the quinoa with the salsa criolla and avocado.

recipes.title: Jerk chicken with rice and peas
recipes.desc: Jamaican jerk-marinated chicken thighs with coconut rice and kidney beans and steamed cabbage.
ingredients: 1 tsp allspice, 1 tsp thyme, juice of 1 lime
1 tsp reduced-sodium soy sauce, 1 tsp honey, 1 tsp oil
½ can (4 oz drained) kidney beans, no salt added
ingredientsMetric: 1 tsp allspice, 1 tsp thyme, juice of 1 lime
1 tsp reduced-salt soy sauce, 1 tsp honey, 1 tsp oil
½ tin (120 g drained) kidney beans, no salt added
steps: Blend the scallions, chili, garlic, ginger, allspice, thyme, lime, soy, honey and oil into a paste. Coat the chicken and marinate at least 30 minutes.
Simmer the rice with the coconut milk, beans, a sprig of thyme and enough water to cook it (about 1¼ cups / 300 ml) for 30–35 minutes.
Grill or roast the chicken at 425°F for 20–25 minutes until charred at the edges and 165°F inside.
Steam the cabbage for 5 minutes and serve everything together.

recipes.title: Ethiopian misir wot
recipes.desc: Red lentils slow-cooked with berbere spice, onions, garlic and ginger, served with brown rice and spinach.
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic and 1 inch ginger, grated
2 cups low-sodium vegetable stock, plus water as needed
⅓ cup brown rice (uncooked), or injera
ingredientsMetric: 3 cloves garlic and 2.5 cm ginger, grated
500 ml low-sodium vegetable stock, plus water as needed
steps: Cook the onions slowly in a dry pan for 8 minutes until soft, then add the oil, garlic, ginger and berbere and cook 2 minutes.
Stir in the tomato paste, lentils and stock. Simmer 25–30 minutes, adding water as needed, until thick and soft.
Meanwhile cook the rice. Wilt the spinach in a pan for 2 minutes.
Serve the lentils with the rice (or injera) and spinach.

recipes.title: Steamed fish with ginger and scallion
recipes.desc: Cantonese-style steamed white fish finished with sizzling oil, ginger, scallion and a little soy.
ingredients: 10 oz cod, sea bass or other white fish
1 inch ginger, cut in fine matchsticks
1 tbsp Shaoxing wine or dry sherry
1 tsp sesame oil and 1 tsp neutral oil
ingredientsMetric: 300 g cod, sea bass or other white fish
2.5 cm ginger, cut in fine matchsticks
1 tbsp Shaoxing wine or dry sherry
1 tsp sesame oil and 1 tsp neutral oil
steps: Cook the rice.
Put the fish on a heatproof plate with half the ginger and the wine. Steam over boiling water, covered, for 8–10 minutes until it flakes. Steam the bok choy alongside for 3 minutes.
Pour off the cooking liquid, top the fish with the remaining ginger and scallions, and drizzle with the soy.
Heat the oils until shimmering and pour over the fish so the aromatics sizzle. Serve with the rice and bok choy.

recipes.title: Chana masala
recipes.desc: A North Indian chickpea curry with tomato, ginger and warm spices, plus spinach, over brown basmati.
ingredients: 3 cloves garlic, 1 inch ginger, 1 green chili
1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 tsp garam masala, ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp ground coriander
1 can (15 oz) chickpeas, no salt added, drained
ingredientsMetric: 3 cloves garlic, 2.5 cm ginger, 1 green chilli
1 tsp cumin seeds, 1 tsp garam masala, ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp ground coriander
1 tin (240 g drained) chickpeas, no salt added
steps: Cook the rice. Toast the cumin seeds in the oil for 30 seconds, then add the onion and cook 8 minutes until golden.
Add the garlic, ginger, chili and ground spices and cook 1 minute. Add the tomatoes and cook down for 5 minutes.
Add the chickpeas, salt and ½ cup (120 ml) water and simmer 10 minutes, mashing a few chickpeas to thicken.
Stir in the spinach until wilted, finish with lemon and cilantro, and serve with the rice.
